# SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.3 document-authority role statement

Status: **CANDIDATE role statement**.

| Artifact | Exact role |
| --- | --- |
| `SCI-MAP-v0.2-SHARED-AUTHORITY` | Sole normative scientific source. |
| Formal Scientific/Engineering Contract PDF | Canonical rendered normative scientific view. |
| Science-Team Rationale | Explanatory scientist-facing view with no independent authority. |
| Engineering Conformance Specification | Prospective evidence, execution, traceability, and verdict procedure with no independent science. |

The formal contract may carry conformance routing and claim boundaries. The
Engineering Conformance Specification supplies the detailed prospective
procedure. All three physical covers must bind the identical shared authority,
author packet, owner directive, and manager build record. This scientific
record does not create or certify generated cover fragments, a build, or PDFs.
